body: Adds an isolated JMA rasrf provider for several-hours-ahead rain forecasts. Existing high-resolution nowcast and Push behavior are unchanged. The provider fetches rasrf target times, reads only the registered location tile pixel, classifies rain intensity using the existing palette logic, and exposes the first forecast rain frame. Includes URL regression coverage.

files.patch:
diff --git a/lib/weather/providers/jma/earlyForecastTileUrl.ts b/lib/weather/providers/jma/earlyForecastTileUrl.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e36035b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/weather/providers/jma/earlyForecastTileUrl.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+import type { JmaEarlyForecastTargetTime } from "./earlyForecastTargetTimes";
+
+export function buildJmaEarlyForecastTileUrl(
+  frame: Pick<JmaEarlyForecastTargetTime, "basetime" | "validtime">,
+  zoom: number,
+  tileX: number,
+  tileY: number,
+): string {
+  return [
+    "https://www.jma.go.jp/bosai/jmatile/data/rasrf",
+    frame.basetime,
+    "none",
+    frame.validtime,
+    "surf",
+    "rasrf",
+    String(zoom),
+    String(tileX),
+    `${tileY}.png`,
+  ].join("/");
+}
